title: Approval Inbox Router I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 117. No model call: route_digest_handler (services/orchestrator/orchestrator/dispatch.py) is pure orchestration -- fetch pending OptionCards from Vault, apply standing permissions and timeouts, rank and budget (services/options_inbox/policy.py's route()), render and post the Teams digest (services/options_inbox/teams_render.py). `output` here is exactly options_inbox.policy.RoutingResult's own field set, so the result_ref/agent_run written for this task is directly comparable across runs. Present for consistency with every other function package's schema.json shape (dispatch.py's _validate_function_output reads it the same way), not because a model output needs validating.

digest_date.description: ISO date this run's digest is for. Injectable for tests; production leaves it unset and the handler uses the run's own date.
